verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a user-facing feature in Dropbox for defining event-triggered rules or automations. Webhooks only notify a developer's app of changes, so they are a building block someone would have to code against, not a rules capability. Dropbox Sign's automatic saving of signed documents is a single built-in behavior, not user-defined rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
